title: Business Impact Manager
description:
**Company:**
------------

Oliver Wyman

**Description:**
----------------

**About Oliver Wyman**

At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.
  
As a business of Marsh, we work alongside the world’s leading experts across risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting. Together with Marsh Risk, Guy Carpenter, and Mercer, we help organizations build resilience and competitive advantages from every angle. With annual revenue over $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues in 130 countries, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.

For more information, visit oliverwyman.com .

**Why we need you**

The APR BIT supports the growth of Oliver Wyman APR by seamlessly enabling regional management activities. The Business Impact Manager will work as part of the Business Impact Team (BIT) to support our regional business priorities and growth. The role will primarily support our regional Practice Leaders in facilitating business development and internal management activities and help drive global and regional processes, compliance and best practices within the remit.

The role will also be responsible for identifying improvement opportunities, recommending and implementing agreed improvement plans, best practices and efficiency increasing initiatives as well as following through on key global and regional processes and KPIs.

Within the APR BIT, this role for a Business Impact Manager will support the Financial Services which include Banking & Financial Services practice and Insurance and Asset Management practice.

**What we will count on you to do**

**Practice Management**

* Support the relevant Industry and/or Capability head in execution of day-to-day Practice to-do list
* Act as a central point of contact for practice staff (Partners, affiliated consultants and specialists), support departments and EAs to ensure and facilitate the effective management of the practice
* PMO responsibilities, track actions and ensure follow-up; support any ad-hoc initiatives for the practice
* Support the practice head with comms, material development for regional and global meetings, work seamlessly with other support functions on reporting and business updates
* Drive and coordinate execution of special projects aligned to the Practice’ top strategic priorities, drawing on resources and expertise from across the regional teams and from the wider firm, globally
* Serve as point person for Practice Partners and for Partners outside the respective teams looking to understand and access practice content, talent, and capabilities
* Plan and drive key all internal practice meetings, e.g. partner meetings, all staff updates, events, offsites, etc.

  + Setting meeting calendars and agendas for key internal meetings e.g. industry leadership meetings, but also for larger gatherings of the Partner group (e.g. at offsite events).
  + Proactively preparing meetings including ownership of materials.
  + Manage business to-do list, prioritizing tasks and initiatives.
  + Tracking actions and ensuring follow-up.
* Liaising with the Practice Partners and the internal support teams to ensure compliance / best practice in relevant processes eg. MIS support, Partner objective setting, etc.
* Work with Finance and market team Partner group to ensure proper management and tracking of investment budget, investments and return
* Coordinate closely with Finance, KM, and Talent Analytics to develop and produce MIS to inform strategy and internal brand building efforts

**Commercial Effectiveness Support**

* Provide specific client/Business Development (BD) support including driving the Practice commercial effectiveness priorities

  + Support and work closely with the Asia BD Manager, to leverage pipeline, data analysis of won/lost opportunities, identify process improvement areas on to their full potential
  + Where needed work with different departments within OW and MMC to support client requests, including Legal, IT, Finance, and Inclusion & Diversity
  + Coordinate with KM, Marketing, and designated Partner and non-Partner leads on commercial priorities
  + Drive the market Key Client account management strategy and discipline, working closely with BD Manager
  + Manage RFP processes

* Business Impact support

  + Be an integral part of the APR Business Impact Team and represent the practice while being the
  + Champion for regional and global best practice and process implementation for the practice
  + Support the APR BIT team with practice level process implementation/ roll out/ follow up such as annual Key Clients review, Partner year end process, other critical business processes
  + Help bring the practice and the partners on relevant change journeys
  + Work with the events team to set and deliver Practice social calendar on time and budget
  + Keep informal pulse on sentiment and flag issues

**What you’ll need to have**

The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in strategic project management, with extensive experience in high-level stakeholder management and team leadership. Exceptional communication and organizational skills are essential for this role.

The ideal candidate will possess 7+ years of experience in a consulting or professional services firm, ideally in the financial services sector.

We except these skills and attributes in the ideal candidate

* Ownership mentality, strong client service focus
* Strong organization skills and excellent attention to detail
* Able to independently manage a varied work volume with conflicting priorities and meet deadlines
* Able to maintain and respect confidentiality with experience of dealing with business-critical issues
* Experience in creating compelling business presentations
* Sense of urgency and able to make good decisions under pressure
* Resilient with experience of dealing with challenging and senior stakeholders
* Collaborative team player with a positive attitude
* Flexible and able to adapt to change
* Problem solver with good judgement
* Execution focused – strong focus on getting the job done

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

### **Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

### **Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.**

title: Strategic Sustainability Manager - Sustainable Natural Rubber
description:
**Your tasks**
--------------

Major activities:

**Global SNR Governance & Policy Leadership**
  

* Develop and maintain SNR governance frameworks and policies.
* Align internal stakeholders to ensure coherent implementation across functions.
* Translate global sustainability expectations into actionable internal guidelines.
* Manage the development of frameworks for internal and external workstreams / projects related to Continental's natural rubber value chain

**Industry Representation & Standard Setting**
  

* Represent Continental in Global Platform for Sustainable Natural Rubber (GPSNR) working groups and industry coalitions and ensure Continental’s interest are considered in the development of the international GPSNR framework.
* Shape sector-wide standards, assurance models, and reporting frameworks.
* Build partnerships with NGOs, customers, and regulators to influence global NR sustainability direction.

**Assurance, Risk & Mitigation Strategy**
  

* Lead the design and execution of SNR assurance processes.
* Develop risk assessment methods for NR supply chain vulnerabilities.
* Establish mitigation plans and oversee follow-up with suppliers.

**Supplier Engagement and Capacity Building**

* Identify and analyse material sustainability risks
* Assess and evaluate the likelihood of sustainability risks and the impact
* Collate and interpret data to support assessment of sustainability risks
* Define long-term supplier improvement roadmaps.
* Lead capability-building programs with strategic suppliers.
* Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement.
* Prioritize and facilitate projects that are aligned with sustainability strategy
* (co-) Manage current and future projects and initiatives (e.g.GIZ, GPSNR capacity building)

  
**Data, Reporting & Transparency Leadership**

* Oversee NR sustainability KPI governance and reporting.
* Lead annual SPOTT, GPSNR, ESRS and customer reporting cycles.
* Improve data systems, tools, and methodologies for transparency.
* Create and maintain a dynamic dashboard for monitoring and reporting of datasets and metrics
* Support any other Natural Rubber reporting requests, eg CDP questionnaire, customer requests
* Ensure yearly submission of GPSNR Reporting Requirements to GPSNR and customers as well as the achievement of minimum standard expected

  
**Carbon Neutrality Pathway for Natural Rubber**
  
Implement carbon guidelines for Purchased Goods in Natural Rubber:

* Engage with industry partners (eg. GPSNR) to look at natural rubber value chain with focus on GHG (Greenhouse gases) inventory management
* Scope 3 catgeory 1 emissions reporting: support and faciliate HQ reporting via data collection along the natural rubber value chain

**Sustainable Natural Rubber Sourcing Implementation**
  
Manage the development of frameworks, strategies and policies for Continental natural rubber, via following focus areas:

* Maintain SNR policy (signed off by Suppliers)
* Survey and supervise implementation of SNR policy by suppliers
* Audits and exception handling
* Identify implications of SNR on supplier portfolio management and purchasing strategy
* Support and guide buyers in sustainable procurement
* Deploy SNR strategy in close collaboration with NR Lead buyers and monitor supplier portfolio conformance
* Ensure conformity of SNR standard and sourcing with GPSNR Assurance model. Lead the yearly assurance process.

  
**Rubberway**

* Lead the Rubberway program by developing and deploying a supplier onboarding concept, ensuring proper data risk assessment and planning and conducting appropriate risk mitigation measures
* Conceptualize methodological improvements for relevant processes and tools (e.g. Rubberway methodology, orrective Action Plan trackers and follow-up) and actively engage with relevant stakeholders to implement changes

Read less

**Your profile**
----------------

**Education/Certification**
  
Degree in Business Administration, Engineering , Sustainability Management, Environmental Sciences, Supply Chain Management, International Relations, or a related field.

**Additional skills and experience**
  
3+ years of experience in sustainability, responsible sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably in the natural rubber or automotive industry.
  
Experience representing organizations in international sustainability platforms or working groups (e.g., GPSNR, ).
  
Technical Skills:
  

* Strong understanding of sustainability standards, assurance models, and risk assessment methodologies (e.g., Ecovadis, Rubberway, ZSL SPOTT).
* Proficiency in sustainability reporting frameworks and tools (e.g., GRI, CDP, GPSNR reporting).
* Data analysis and audit preparation skills to ensure high-quality, verifiable reporting.

Stakeholder Engagement:
  

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with internal departments (e.g., Legal, R&D, Marketing) and external stakeholders (e.g., NGOs, suppliers, customers).
* Skilled in negotiation and advocacy to represent corporate interests in multi-stakeholder initiatives.

Advanced Interpersonal Skills:
  

* Negotiation
* Intercultural Communication

-------------

Continental Tires Holding Singapore Pte Ltd is a subsidiary of Continental. Our major tasks is to ensure the supply of natural rubber to Continental's tire and technical rubber plants on time, in the right quantity and quality, at competitive prices and responsibly sourced. Like everywhere else in Continental, we believe in great people culture and foster team spirit. We offer a friendly working atmosphere, flexibility and fairness.

Continental develops pioneering technologies and services for sustainable and connected mobility of people and their goods. Founded in 1871, the technology company offers safe, efficient, intelligent and affordable solutions for vehicles, machines, traffic and transportation. With its premium portfolio in the car, truck, bus, two-wheel and specialty tire segment, the Tires group sector stands for innovative solutions in tire technology. Intelligent products and services related to tires and the promotion of sustainability complete the product portfolio. For specialist dealers and fleet management, Tires offers digital tire monitoring and tire management systems, in addition to other services, with the aim of keeping fleets mobile and increasing their efficiency. **Date:** 3 Jul 2026

**Location:** SG

**Who we are:**

Digital Edge DC (Digital Edge) is a leading data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. We seek to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve.

Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy-efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed capital.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, with 30+ data centers in operations and under construction, and this role is an exciting opportunity to join the team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

**Our values:**

  

* **Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.**
* **Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.**
* **Strive: We are driven and determined.**
* **Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.**
* **Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.**

  

**What we need:**

  

**What we need:**

Responsible for executing the company’s global Corporate Social Responsibility strategy, translating ESG direction into impactful, measurable programmes that drive both employee engagement and external social impact across all markets.

  

Reporting to the Head of ESG (Chief Sustainability Officer), this role operationalises the CSR platform by embedding CSR into the employee experience, strengthening community partnerships, and ensuring consistent delivery of initiatives aligned to the organisation’s ESG goals, brand, and values.

  

The role is highly collaborative, partnering closely with General Affairs, HR, Corporate Communications, country leadership and external stakeholders (which may include, joint venture partners, educational organizations, non-profit organizations, and community officials in the jurisdictions neighbouring our data centers, among others) to deliver scalable, high-impact programmes that enhance employee engagement, employer brand, and community outcomes.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

**CSR Strategy Execution and Programme Delivery**

* Operationalise the global CSR framework and pillars defined by the Head of ESG, ensuring consistent but localised implementation across all countries.
* Translate strategy into clear annual CSR roadmaps, programmes, and campaigns with defined KPIs and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of enterprise CSR priorities such as:
  + Develop greenhouse gas (GHG), carbon offset, and biodiversity replenishment programs, that are relevant to the data center industry, that align with our stated ESG goals
  + Community engagement and impact
  + STEM and education initiatives
  + Environmental volunteering
  + Inclusion and industry access
* Ensure localisation of programmes while maintaining global alignment and brand consistency.
* Work with legal and compliance teams to vet our CSR partners

  

**Employee Engagement and HR Partnership**

  

* Partner with internal teams to embed CSR and culture-building into everyday life at Digital Edge.
* Design and implement employee volunteering frameworks, giving programmes and engagement campaigns.
* Position CSR as a core lever for:
  + Employee engagement and team building
  + Personal development
  + Culture and values activation
* Develop toolkits and guidance for managers to drive participation at scale across all locations.

  

**External Education, Social Impact and Partnerships**

  

* Build and manage strategic partnerships with NGOs, educational institutions, community organisations and industry bodies
* Identify and scale initiatives that strengthen the company’s social licence to operate in local markets.
* Drive programmes aligned to workforce strategy (e.g. STEM pipelines, community talent development) including but not limited to Educational Institution relationships and curriculum building, employee guest lecturing and industry awareness initiatives
* Represent the company in CSR-related forums and partnerships as delegated by the Head of ESG.

  

**Governance, Measurement and Reporting**

  

* Establish and maintain CSR metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks aligned to ESG reporting
* Track programme effectiveness including participation rates, social impact outcomes, and brand impact.
* Support ESG reporting cycles by providing robust CSR data and narratives for:
  + Annual sustainability reports
  + Investor and customer disclosures
  + Employer branding and communications
* Ensure strong governance and consistency across markets.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Work closely with:
  + Corporate Communications on storytelling and brand amplification
  + Country leadership on local execution
  + Commercial and customer teams where CSR supports customer engagement or RFP positioning
* Act as the central coordination point for CSR activity across the organisation.

  

**Culture, Capability and Internal Awareness**

  

* Build internal awareness and capability around CSR through:
  + Campaigns and communications
  + Leadership engagement
  + Employee storytelling
* Embed CSR as a visible and tangible part of the company’s purpose and values.
* Support a culture of community contribution, inclusivity and responsible business practices

  

**The successful candidate:**

* 8+ years of experience in CSR, social impact or related fields in a multi geographical role.
* Proven track record in executing multi-country CSR or employee engagement programmes.
* Experience working in complex, matrixed organisations across Asia or globally.
* Strong partnership experience with HR, Communications and external stakeholders.
* Experience in sectors such as infrastructure, technology, data centres or industrial environments preferred

  

**Key Attributes**

  

* Execution-focused operator with the ability to translate strategy into delivery at scale.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability across all levels.
* Commercially aware, with the ability to align CSR outcomes to business priorities.
* Highly collaborative, culturally aware and adaptable across markets.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to connect purpose, people and impact.

  

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

description:
**About ARU:**

ARU is a global university transforming lives through innovative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial education and research. ARU holds a gold award for the quality of its education, awarded through the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF).

  

ARU’s research institutes and four faculties bridge scientific, technical, and creative fields. We deliver impactful research which tackles pressing issues and makes a real difference to our communities. Our academic excellence has been recognised by the UK’s Higher Education funding bodies, with 16 of our research areas assessed as world leading. We are the largest provider of Nursing, Midwifery, Health, and Social Care students in the East of England, and we are also among the UK’s leading universities for degree apprenticeship provision, working with hundreds of employers across the UK.

  

**About the Role:**

Learning Development Services (LDS) play a pivotal role developing academically credible, business relevant distance learning courses, using learning technologies to enhance student experience and to help equip students with the skills fit for 21st century employment. With a truly diverse, international student population we provide the opportunity and flexibility that students need to be successful in their studies.

  

**Distance Learning Tutor (Part-time, flexible contract, UK home-based)**

**Cert HE Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship.**

We are seeking a Distance Learning Tutor to deliver on the module **Sustainability and Environmental Legislation, Policy and Economics** which forms part of our new online **Cert HE Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver nine live online workshops and lectures, over a 12-week trimester to provide deeper insight, discussion, and practical application of course concepts.
* Manage the delivery and support of the module materials that apprentice’s access and complete on their own schedule, including posting weekly announcements, facilitating discussion posts, coordinating online activities, and responding to student enquiries via email.
* Support apprentices as they progress through their self-paced learning materials, ensuring a high-quality and engaging learning experience.
* Complete marking of 1st attempt and resubmissions scripts.

  

**We are particularly interested in tutors with the following key knowledge and skills in:**

* Practical and theoretic background in the core sustainability and corporate responsibility topics:

* Legislation, standards, and policy frameworks
* Sustainability and corporate responsibility reporting systems
* Environmental and social economic methods
* Sustainable finance
* Fundraising strategies and tools

* Ability to translate own professional practice and theoretical grounding to apprentices

* To develop materials and taught sessions that enable apprentices to apply their learning to their workplace

You will have relevant academic qualifications and a minimum of a full postgraduate qualification in the relevant subject area, along with experience of applying skills, methods and techniques in a learning and teaching environment. You will be IT literate, and student focussed with good communication and interpersonal skills. Learning Management Systems experience would be desirable, but not essential.

To be eligible to apply for this role you must be based in and have a Right to Work in the UK.

Hours are set each trimester based on cohort size and module credit value. **The delivery rate is £50.26 per hour** (including marking). For example, a 15-credit module with 15-18 students would typically equate to a **57-hour contract.** Please note: this module does not run every trimester.

The Sustainability and Environmental Legislation, Policy and Economics module is scheduled to commence in January 2027. The successful candidate will be required in September 2026 to support module content development. **Content development work is contracted separately at a rate of £20.10 per hour.**

Interviews for this post are likely to be held on 13 August 2026.

**To apply for this role, or if you have queries, please send a CV and covering letter demonstrating your skills and experience to Beverley Read:** **beverley.read@aru.ac.uk**

Find out more about working with us and how we recruit.

We have an agile working culture and offer an extensive range of benefits including a generous holiday entitlement, occupational pension schemes, training and development opportunities, travel to work scheme and a competitive relocation package. Visit our benefits page for full details.

***We are committed to safeguarding and promoting welfare of our staff and students and expect all staff to share this commitment.***

***We value diversity at ARU and are committed to being inclusive. We welcome applications from all sections of the community.***

*We have a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK and will conduct Right to Work checks in line with UKVI’s Right to Work policy and our own institutional policy. Furthermore, we must note:*

* **Applicants applying from outside the UK:** At this time, ARU is unable to sponsor applicants applying from overseas for a Worker Route visa.

* **Applicants already in the UK:** ARU is unable to offer Worker Route visa sponsorship to applicants whose salary does not meet our minimum sponsorship threshold, which aligns with roles at Grade 6 and above.

  

***Committed to being inclusive and open to discuss flexible working.***

  

We reserve the right to close this vacancy once we have received sufficient applications.

**Guidance Notes:**

Please download the Job Description Person Specification for key requirements. To apply, demonstrate how your skills and experience meet the criteria.
